description.value:
You have devoted your life to the lost and fallen cultures of the past: visiting their ruins, deciphering their writings, and studying their surviving masterpieces. You may have studied at Morgrave University or a similar institution, balancing time in the library with fieldwork in remote ruins. Some archaeologists loot the past for wealth or fame, but most see learning from it as their calling. Either way, Eberron's archaeologists blend the knowledge of scholars with the toughness of treasure hunters.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftSkilled0000]{Skilled}

Skill Proficiencies: History and Survival

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCartograph]{Cartographer's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCartograph]{Cartographer's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLanternBull]{Bullseye Lantern}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagMap00000000]{Map}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCaseMaporSc]{Map or Scroll Case}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagShovel00000]{Shovel}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTent0000000]{Tent}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav]{Traveler's Clothes}, 17 GP; or (B) 50 GP
